svg.metadata: {"story":"Jeremiah","act":3,"chapter":"Ch.3 · At the Temple Gate","scene":"A","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The Lord tells Jeremiah to stand at the temple gate and cry: trust not in the temple itself; do justice, hear the widow's plea. Stage: a temple gate at midday, a lone voice in a busy court, the poor and the blind at the steps; the stone of the temple and the people at its feet.","materials":["assets/materials/stone-flagstone.svg"],"seed":1}
